question.prompt: Point \(P\) lies inside \(\angle AOB\), \(PD\perp OA\) at \(D\), \(PE\perp OB\) at \(E\), \(PD=PE\), and \(\angle DOP=25^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle AOB\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: Since \(PD=PE\) and \(P\) lies inside the angle, \(OP\) bisects \(\angle AOB\), so \(\angle AOB=2\times25^\circ=50^\circ\).
solutions.title: Apply the angle bisector criterion
